thread:
Maya Chen: Hey team — new draft for the Optimize launch blog is live. Main asks: editorial tone sweep, legal check on benchmark language, and confirm webinar CTA + HubSpot routing. Doc: https://docs.google.com/d/1optimize...

Alex Rivera: on it. quick skim shows hero is a bit heavy. I can try 3 variants.

Sarah Li: thanks Alex. prefer something punchy and benefit-led. i'll drop 2 alt hero lines in the doc.

Jon Park: Benchmarks section: can we include the test harness details (model, seq len p95, batch config)? Ops needs that for the asset deck.

Maya Chen: added a short test appendix with model/gpu config. flagged numbers as median across runs.

legal-bot: Automated scan: "20-40%" flagged as 'up to' style claim. Please provide CI or rephrase as typical range with footnote.

Maya Chen: noted — updating to "typical 20–40% reduction observed in our test suite; results vary by model and prompt length" and will add footnote with test params.

Kevin O'Neill: HubSpot: use form id 12345. Routing: utm_source=blog, utm_campaign=optimize_launch. Map registrants to list "Launch_Optimize" and tag "optimize_webinar".

Maya Chen: adding UTMs and CTA button links. For hot leads, proposed routing: if attended && engaged => assign to sales-sdr queue; otherwise nurture flow. Putting conditional in the doc.

Alex Rivera: hero pick: "Cut inference cost — keep output quality." dropping in now.

Sarah Li: looks clean. small nit: add short customer quote placeholder above benchmarks.

Maya Chen: good call. i'll add a placeholder and reach out to AE for a quote. Plan: legal quick-pass after I update bench phrasing, then final publish slot signoff tomorrow morning. Any other blockers?

Jon Park: none from benchmarks side.

legal-bot: Awaiting updated phrasing for quick-pass.

Maya Chen: I'll update and ping. Thanks everyone :rocket:
